python3 - << 'PY'
import workcell
for i, c in enumerate(range(1, 11)):
    item = f"C-{c:02d}"
    if c <= 6:
        loc, slot = "crate-A", str(c)
    else:
        loc, slot = "crate-B", str(c - 6)
    r = workcell.call("robot", "pick", item)
    print(f"PICK {item}: ok={r.ok} {r.text}")
    if not r.ok:
        break
    r = workcell.call("robot", "place", loc, slot)
    print(f"PLACE {item} -> {loc} {slot}: ok={r.ok} {r.text}")
    if not r.ok:
        break
print("--- status ---")
print(workcell.call("cell", "status").text)
print(workcell.call("robot", "status").text)
PY

# Robot cell RC-4: operator workstation

## Cell
- Robot: Universal Robots UR5e with a Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, inside a guard fence with one hinged guard door.
